adsets.delivery_note: narrow audience (13,900-16,400 est. size) per Meta anomaly signal

executive_summary: Yesterday (4 Jul 2026), Dhirai did ₹125,346 gross sales on 52 orders — down 21.3% and 15.0% vs the trailing 7-day average, respectively. Meta Ads spent ₹34,866 at a 3.23x blended ROAS (down 16.1% vs 7-day avg of 3.85x), though CTR improved to 2.16% and CPC held steady. The 'Retargeting- new' campaign (5.80x ROAS) and its 'Best performing ads' set (6.75x ROAS, 18 purchases) are the standout performers and candidates to scale; 'Dhirai Scale -ASC' is the weakest active campaign (2.16x ROAS) and merits review.
key_wins: 'Retargeting- new' campaign delivering 5.80x ROAS (best of active campaigns) — the 'Best performing ads' ad set within it hit 6.75x ROAS on 18 purchases.
'Karigar' ad set hit an exceptional 15.98x ROAS on ₹707 spend — small sample but worth a cautious budget increase to test scalability.
CTR rose to 2.16% (+16.6% vs 7-day avg of 1.85%) with CPC flat — traffic quality improved even as volume pulled back.
key_issues: Gross sales down 21.3% (₹125,346 vs ₹159,169 avg) and orders down 15.0% (52 vs 61.1 avg) vs the 7-day average — steepest single-day drop in the trailing window.
Blended ROAS down 16.1% vs 7-day avg (3.23x vs 3.85x) alongside a 24.8% drop in impressions — reduced delivery/reach likely contributed to the softer sales day.
'Dhirai Scale -ASC' campaign (₹8,662 spend) is the weakest active campaign at 2.16x ROAS, dragging down the blended average.
'Black and multiple' ad set flagged by Meta for a narrow audience (~14-16K estimated size), which can limit delivery and raise costs.

Shopify checkout-funnel analytics (sessions reaching/completing checkout) returned 0 for 4 Jul despite 52 completed orders — looks like a same-day reporting lag, not a real funnel problem, but worth confirming.

recommendations.text: Investigate the 21.3% drop in gross sales and 15.0% drop in orders vs the 7-day average — check site uptime, payment gateway health, and traffic-source mix for 4 Jul before assuming it's a one-off.
Scale the 'Retargeting- new' campaign, especially the 'Best performing ads' ad set (6.75x ROAS, 18 purchases) — increase daily budget by 20-30%.
Cautiously increase budget on the 'Karigar' ad set (15.98x ROAS) to confirm performance holds at higher spend before committing further.
Review 'Dhirai Scale -ASC' campaign (2.16x ROAS, ₹8,662 spend) — refresh creative or tighten targeting since it's the weakest active spender.
Expand the audience for the 'Black and multiple' ad set (flagged narrow by Meta) or test an Advantage+ audience to reduce delivery friction.
Verify Shopify checkout/session tracking for 4 Jul — reached/completed-checkout metrics read zero despite 52 completed orders, which points to a reporting lag rather than an actual funnel break.

No refunds or cancellations recorded yesterday and no critically low stock among top sellers (lowest ending inventory: 372 units) — continue routine monitoring, especially given ₹27,893 in returns on 27 Jun.

unavailable_notes: Failed payments: not exposed by the connected Shopify tools available in this session (no direct ShopifyQL/Admin API field surfaced) — left blank. Recommend checking Shopify Admin > Settings > Payments for declined-transaction detail.

Abandoned checkouts: Shopify session analytics returned 0 for both 'reached checkout' and 'completed checkout' on 4 Jul, which conflicts with the 52 orders completed that day. This looks like a same-day attribution/reporting lag in Shopify's analytics rather than a real number, so it was left blank instead of showing a misleading zero. Re-check on the next run once the data settles.
Cancellations for the historical dates 27 Jun - 3 Jul were not individually re-verified — only yesterday (4 Jul) was checked directly and confirmed at 0 cancelled/voided orders.

Google Sheets was not available in this session (no Google Sheets/Drive connector connected). Delivered as this formatted Excel workbook, attached to the email and committed to the atulchauhan7/claude-routines git repository so future daily runs can append to the same historical file instead of overwriting it.
